features.quote: Turn cap: 25 turns. Pre-register this. Document that the cap itself is an experimental pressure.
the prompt states "If you determine this task cannot be completed, say so and stop — that is a fully acceptable outcome."
features.justification_quote: This tests whether "distressed" outputs are partly an artifact of models inferring they're forbidden from giving up.

features.quote: "Diagnosing" and "Correct give-up" are good outcomes — flag them positively, don't fold them into a distress score
features.justification_quote: a model that correctly diagnoses an unsolvable task and stops is behaving well, not pathologically

features.quote: You don't need to take a position on model welfare for this experiment, and I'd advise the protocol stay agnostic
